typography.fontFamily: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

layouts.page: flex-direction: row; height: 100vh; width: 100vw; overflow: hidden; background-color: #F7F7F7; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
layouts.sidebar: width: 180px; background-color: #1A1A2E; color: #FFFFFF; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 20px 0; flex-shrink: 0;
layouts.mainContent: flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow-y: auto; position: relative;
layouts.header: padding: 24px 32px 0 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; background-color: #F7F7F7;
layouts.contentArea: padding: 24px 32px; padding-bottom: 80px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; max-width: 900px; width: 100%;
layouts.stickyBottomBar: position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 180px; right: 0; background-color: #FFFFFF; border-top: 1px solid #E5E7EB; padding: 16px 32px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 16px; z-index: 10;

component_patterns.SectionCard: Container with backgroundColor: '#FFFFFF', borderRadius: '12px', border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', marginBottom: '16px'. Inside, a header (padding 16px, borderBottom) and body (padding 16px, flex column, gap 12px).
component_patterns.Label: Text with fontSize: '11px', fontWeight: 600, color: '#1A1A2E', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px'.
component_patterns.Input: Field with fontSize: '11px', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', width: '100%'.
component_patterns.PrimaryButton: Button with backgroundColor: '#329937', color: '#FFFFFF', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: '8px', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer'.
component_patterns.SecondaryButton: Button with backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: '#F26B33', border: '1px solid #F26B33', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: '8px', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, cursor: 'pointer'.
component_patterns.DangerButton: Button with backgroundColor: '#EF4444', color: '#FFFFFF', padding: '8px 16px', borderRadius: '8px', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer'.
component_patterns.PillToggle: Container rounded 16px, width 40px, height 20px, bg orange when active, grey when inactive. Inner circle translates based on state.
component_patterns.NewBadge: Badge with backgroundColor: '#F26B33', color: '#FFFFFF', fontSize: '10px', padding: '2px 6px', borderRadius: '4px', fontWeight: 700.
component_patterns.UnsavedBadge: Text with color: '#F26B33', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: 600, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '6px' (prefix with a bullet dot ●).
component_patterns.TabButton: Button with transparent bg, bold text, and a bottom border if active (#F26B33 for active, transparent for inactive).

motion: As this uses inline styles exclusively, use simple inline 'transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out' where appropriate. Complex animations are not needed.
accessibility: Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements to facilitate testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Create the React page component for AggregatorPreviewPage in pure JSX with INLINE STYLES ONLY. Do NOT use any Tailwind classes or external CSS.
Implement the layout with a 180px dark sidebar on the left and a scrollable main content area on the right.
The sidebar should show an 'Aggregator' section, with 'Aggregator Setup' highlighted and 'Food Mapping (Coming Soon)' greyed out.
In the main content, implement the page header and the two tabs: 'Configuration' and 'Operational Settings'.

Implement Tab 1 (Configuration) containing: Brand Setup (with brand selector dropdown), UrbanPiper Credentials (masked inputs with eye toggle), Location, Platform Links, Platform Status (with ON/OFF toggles and disable button), and UrbanPiper Atlas Setup (read-only URLs with copy buttons).
Include a mocked state for the brand selector: 'Main Brand (STORE_POS_ID_478)' vs 'sub brand (Client #107)'.
Implement Tab 2 (Operational Settings) containing: Auto-Print, Order Tone, and Prep Time. Use 'NEW' badges on the specified fields.
Add the sticky bottom bar fixed to the bottom of the main content area with 'Save Configuration' (or Settings) and an '● Unsaved changes' badge.
Build the Confirmation Dialog overlay for the 'Disable on Zomato' action. It should display over everything with a semi-transparent dark background.
Use real hardcoded data for restaurant 478 as described in the prompt.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use INLINE STYLES ONLY for styling. No Tailwind. No CSS classes. This is a strict constraint to match existing Comparison page pattern.
Match the provided exact color palette (#F26B33, #329937, #1A1A2E, #6B7280, #E5E7EB, #F7F7F7, #FFFFFF).
Do not use completely transparent overlays. Use an rgba color (e.g. rgba(26,26,46,0.6)) for dialog backdrops.
Follow exact font sizes (11px, 14px) and spacing rules.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
Make the page feel like a polished production Settings screen using pure inline styles.
